name: North Dakota DWR Water Well Contractor Licensure

agency.name: North Dakota Department of Water Resources

termsReviewNotes: North Dakota state privacy terms were identified, but source-specific publication, redistribution, and privacy review has not been completed.
updateFrequency: unknown; verify against the official DWR water-well contractor page and certified well drillers database before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Water well pump and pitless unit installers
knownExclusions: This source is limited to DWR water-well, monitoring-well, pump/pitless, and geothermal drilling/installing licensure and does not represent general contractor, electrical, plumbing, asbestos, local permits, or non-DWR records.

DWR notes that in-state and out-of-state water-well contractors or pump and pitless unit installers may also need Secretary of State business certification and a general contractor license for jobs of $4,000 or greater.

researchEvidence.note: Official DWR water-well contractor page reviewed; it states DWR licenses water well contractors, pump and pitless unit installers, monitoring well contractors, and geothermal system drillers and links a certified well drillers database.

Official DEQ water-well information page reviewed; it states all drilling and construction of water wells or monitoring wells and installation of pumps or pitless units must be performed by a DWR-licensed contractor and notes SOS contractor-license overlap for jobs of $4,000 or greater.
